name: sportify-main-2
description: - **Admin role**: set `role: "ADMIN"` on `users/{uid}` from the Firebase console, or run   `ADMIN_UID=<uid> node scripts/seed.js`. Admins land on a separate Admin graph (Venues, Payments, Reviews).   Clients cannot change their own `role` (see `firestore.rules`). - **Admin**: add / delete venues, edit court prices and opening hours, refund any paid booking   (callable `adminRefund`), moderate reviews. - **Reviews**: one per user per venue; `onReviewWritten` keeps `venues.rating` and `reviewCount` in sync. - **Open Play**: create games, request to join, host approves/declines, full games close to the public. - **Matchmaking**: public `players/{uid}` profile (level + sport), invites accepted/declined by the receiver. - **Scores & stats**: `matches` collection; wins / win rate are derived on the device. - **Explore filters**: city, minimum rating, maximum "from" price. - Deploy: `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,functions`.
